items.title: Freelancers Hub
items.developmentArea: Full-Stack Web Development (Front-End, Back-End, and Databases)
items.shortDescription: A graduation project connecting freelancers with project owners, featuring account and project management, search functionality, an administrative dashboard, and transaction records.
items.overview:
Freelancers Hub is an academic graduation project developed as part of the Intermediate Diploma in Full-Stack Web Development at the Applied College, Taibah University. The project aims to establish an online platform connecting freelancers with project owners, facilitating project publishing, opportunity discovery, and the management of user and project information through an organized digital environment.

The platform supports three account types: freelancer, project owner, and administrator. Project owners can create and manage projects, search for freelancers by name or skill, and review their professional profiles. Freelancers can maintain profiles featuring their skills, experience, hourly rates, and portfolio work, as well as browse, search, and filter available projects.

The platform includes transaction records and their associated statuses. Freelancers and project owners can view only their own transaction records, while administrators can manage recorded transaction statuses. These records do not represent actual payment processing, as no real payment gateway was integrated.

The administrative dashboard provides statistics covering users, freelancers, project owners, projects, and transactions. Administrators can manage users, projects, categories, and skills, as well as review and approve or reject project publication requests.

The project also includes interfaces and database structures related to project proposals. However, proposal submission and management were not completed as operational features and remain part of the planned future development.

features.title: Account and Permission Management
items: Register freelancer and project owner accounts and authenticate users according to their account types.
Manage personal information and user profiles based on role-specific permissions.

features.title: Professional Profiles
items: Create freelancer profiles featuring specializations, skills, experience, hourly rates, and portfolio work.
Browse freelancer profiles and search for freelancers by name or skill.

features.title: Project Management
items: Create projects with titles, descriptions, and budgets.
View, edit, and delete projects owned by the project owner.
Browse available projects using search and filtering features.

features.title: Transaction Records
items: Allow freelancers and project owners to view their own transaction records with read-only access.
Enable administrators to manage recorded transaction statuses: pending, completed, failed, and refunded.
features.note: This functionality concerns transaction records and their statuses within the system. No real payment gateway, fund transfer, or financial refund processing was implemented.

features.title: Administrative Dashboard
items: Display statistics for users, freelancers, project owners, projects, and transactions.
Manage users, projects, categories, and skills.
Review project publication requests and approve or reject them.

features.title: User Experience
items: Provide search, filtering, and sorting capabilities to help users find relevant content.
Display clear success, error, and empty-state messages.
Organize navigation and content according to user account types.

features.title: Project Proposal System — Future Development
items: Allow freelancers to submit proposals containing an amount, estimated duration, and message.
Track proposal statuses such as pending, accepted, rejected, and withdrawn.
features.note: Related interfaces and database structures are available, but proposal submission and management were not completed as operational features.
